ui.briefing.body: Welcome aboard Captain... your ship has been fully stocked with enough fuel, food, and supplies for your journey. Your crew is on board and have taken their positions in preparation for departure. I wish you the best of luck and may the solar winds of Xaldur be in your favor.

sel.orders: Captain, Your orders are to select a course and cargo from the list below. Intelligence reports show an increase in space pirate activity in most sectors of the Parvin Frontier. The mission rewards reflect the amount of relative danger and risk for each course. Bonuses will be paid for prompt delivery of perishable cargo. Please examine the resumes and select one candidate (out of six) to fill each crew position for the five departments.
sel.footer.select: Use direction keys to select candidate
sel.footer.open: Press ENTER key to see personnel file
crew.boris.name: Boris
resume.boris.name: Boris Tarkov
resume.boris.qualifications: Expert on GX75 Cannon. Good with Sonic Missiles & M26 Battle Thermos.
resume.boris.education: Studied history & strategic tactical training at School of War.
resume.boris.experience: Jagon Wars, 3 yrs. Earth Defense Sqd., 9 yrs.
resume.boris.strengths: No family. Fearless. aggressive & precise. Quick reactions. Has a passion for combat.
resume.boris.weakness: Suspicious of others. Is a loner and a poor communicator. Lousy with blasters.
crew.q6d.name: Q6-D
resume.q6d.name: Q6-D
resume.q6d.qualifications: Superior rating on Interstellar 32 Blaster. Has seen combat in regional war.
resume.q6d.education: Specialist in strategic thought & logic. Lexidata Strategic Academy.
resume.q6d.strengths: Quick thinking. Cool in most situations. Communicates clearly.
resume.q6d.weakness: Inexperienced. Uses programmed responses & required protocol in communications.
crew.yeela.name: Yeela
resume.yeela.name: Yeela
resume.yeela.qualifications: Top rated on Sonic Missiles & M26 Battle Thermos. Is good with blasters.
resume.yeela.experience: Defender of Glork during local wars, 110 yrs.
resume.yeela.strengths: Reliable, loyal & friendly. Good natural judgement. Has telepathic ability.
resume.yeela.weakness: Can't handle stress Sometimes too emotional. Not very self-motivated. No other information.
crew.alzott.name: Al
resume.alzott.name: Al (Bull's Eye) Zott
resume.alzott.qualifications: Expert on Interstellar 32 Blaster & M26 Battle Thermos. Wizard on GX75 Cannon.
resume.alzott.education: Studied advanced gunnery systems at the Intergalatic Space Academy.
resume.alzott.strengths: Professional & strong leader. Tactical & technical expert. Single. Cool under pressure.
resume.alzott.weakness: Poor with missiles. Hot tempered! Independent & a loner. Tends to be rebellious.
crew.skulard.name: Skulard
resume.skulard.name: Skulard Prablyk
resume.skulard.qualifications: Adept on Traplonic Detonator. Wizard on Sonic Missiles & GX75 Cannon.
resume.skulard.education: Philosophy, Logic & Strategic History at Balnarv Weapons Institute.
resume.skulard.strengths: Quick & precise. Has a wide range of body temperature tolerance. Fluent in Zabian languages.
resume.skulard.weakness: Sometimes gets philisophical regarding decisions and actions of others.Poor stress reaction
crew.grolo.name: Grolo
resume.grolo.name: Grolo
resume.grolo.qualifications: Excellent Sonic Missile operator. Ok on interstellar 32 Blasters & GX75 Cannon.
resume.grolo.education: Studied advanced gunnery systems & weapons technology, 5 yrs.
resume.grolo.experience: Scollos map team, sighting assistant, 2 yrs.
resume.grolo.strengths: Even tempered, friendly & helpful. A sharp thinker. Known as a very good shot.
resume.grolo.weakness: Has a very large appetite. Poor with thermo weapons. Not very well self-motivated.
crew.jaru.name: Jaru
resume.jaru.name: Jaru Lagon
resume.jaru.qualifications: Expert rating on 434-CM Tracking Lock Sys. Only fair on info scanners.
resume.jaru.education: Attended Palagonon Flight Institute. Graduated fifth in her class.
resume.jaru.strengths: Efficient, precise & self- motivated. Independent aggressive nature.
resume.jaru.weakness: Communicates poorly with males and vaccdroids. Doesn't take commands well. Can't handle stress well.
crew.phyzo.name: Phyzo
resume.phyzo.name: Phyzo Thynx
resume.phyzo.qualifications: Vast experience with XTN Mid-Range Info Scan system. Very good with it
resume.phyzo.education: Studied astronomy & mathematical theory at Federation Space Academy.
resume.phyzo.experience: Jr. Scan Manager for 3 yrs. on Jagon Cruiser.
resume.phyzo.strengths: Strong telepathic senses. Responds to commands well. Reacts well under pressure.
resume.phyzo.weakness: Poor verbal communicator. Weak performer with most tracking lock systems.
crew.blustan.name: Blustan
resume.blustan.name: Blustan
resume.blustan.qualifications: Superior on XTN Mid-Range Info Scanner. Good with all Flarvok Radar Scopes.
resume.blustan.education: Studied logic and intergalactic philosophy at the Zykronkan Institute.
resume.blustan.experience: Pargonic explorers and Jaarng Mapping Team.
resume.blustan.strengths: Communicates well. Has a logically structured mind & speaks 4 languages. Finishes jobs efficiently.
resume.blustan.weakness: Can't handle stress Gossips & is inquisitive. Has never exhibited any self-motivation.
crew.nargo.name: Nargo
resume.nargo.name: Nargo Kloya
resume.nargo.qualifications: Displays good ability with 434 Tracking Lock System. OK with XTN Info Scanner
resume.nargo.education: Studied 7 yrs. at Transjovian Institute as a Communication Translator.
resume.nargo.experience: 2 yrs. service on the Gorlin Exploratory Team.
resume.nargo.strengths: Good communicator. Responds well under stress. Friendly, but shy. Very strong telepathic skills.
resume.nargo.weakness: Quiet, sometimes to an extreme! Moody & socially introvered during long missions.
crew.churglk.name: Churglik
resume.churglk.name: Churglik
resume.churglk.qualifications: Good with most info scanners. Also rated good on 434 Tracking Lock System.
resume.churglk.education: No formal courses. Self taught in sub-visual detection & identification.
resume.churglk.experience: Contracted short- term on Xeon Scouting Team
resume.churglk.strengths: Loyal & dependable Good self-motivation. Excellent endurance levels. Communicates well.
resume.churglk.weakness: Gets nervous & flusters easily. Doesn't work quickly under pressure situations.
crew.mike.name: Mike
resume.mike.name: Mike of Morgon
resume.mike.qualifications: Is tops on a 434-CM Tracking Lock Sys. Intergalactic troubleshooting expert.
resume.mike.education: Bringum Younger University on Spaceball Scholarship.
resume.mike.experience: Based on Earth at King Hi Terrestrials Team
resume.mike.strengths: Loves danger. Independent & friendly. Upper command material. Strong & gets his way.
resume.mike.weakness: Can be distracted easily. Is a family man who tends to overcommit. Poor with the new info scanners.
crew.klg.name: KLG-7A
resume.klg.name: KLG-7A
resume.klg.qualifications: Excellent risk analyst with XTN Mid-Range Info Scanner. Expert interpreter.
resume.klg.education: Intelligence bank programmed for 4 yrs. at M.U.T. Institute, Earth.
resume.klg.experience: 2 Yrs. on Scollian exploration mapping crew.
resume.klg.strengths: Acute eyesight & very precise in his actions. Extremely rugged individual.
resume.klg.weakness: Has a strong liking for joking around. Poor at evasive maneuvers.
crew.tegra.name: Tegra
resume.tegra.name: Tegra Kloya
resume.tegra.qualifications: Rated expert in evasive maneuvers. OK with XTN Info Scanner System.
resume.tegra.education: Transjovian Institute as acoordinate and navigation interpreter.
resume.tegra.experience: Earth moon mapping & exploration crew, 1 yr.
resume.tegra.strengths: Strong life force. Quick and cool in stress situations. Has very strong telepathic receptor skills.
resume.tegra.weakness: Inexperienced. Has a temper if challenged. Tends to play with her telepathic abilities.
crew.nik.name: Nik
resume.nik.name: Nik Relpo
resume.nik.qualifications: Certified expert at evasive maneuvers. Extremely fast reaction times.
resume.nik.education: Completed 6 month Alfa-Rad Detector course. Other info. Unknown.
resume.nik.experience: No information in Federation data base.
resume.nik.strengths: Good listener & communicator. Seems to be reliable & loyal to current mission.
resume.nik.weakness: Doesn't socialize well with others. Doesn't have many friends. Frail.
crew.bronx.name: Bronxaag
resume.bronx.name: Bronxaag
resume.bronx.qualifications: Best quadrant risk analyzer in the business. Good evasive navigator.
resume.bronx.education: No formal education. Only field experience.
resume.bronx.strengths: Understands many different alien languages. Friendly and loyal. A quick thinker.
resume.bronx.weakness: Has a long history of strange behaviors and nervousness. Extremely frail individual.
crew.aymu.name: Aymu
resume.aymu.name: Mr. Aymu Skump
resume.aymu.qualifications: Good risk evaluation ability. Has knowlege of all current quadrant equip.
resume.aymu.education: Field experience & 2 yrs. course study at the Transjovian Institute.
resume.aymu.experience: Chief navigational officer for VAX-5 missions.
resume.aymu.strengths: Cool attitude. Very professional. Rugged. Communicates well with crew members and upper command.
resume.aymu.weakness: Slow response time Sometimes too occupied with policy and politics when he should be responsive.
crew.yenx.name: Yenx
resume.yenx.name: Yenx
resume.yenx.qualifications: Expert Radar Vopation & Vector Analyzer operator. Good at evasive maneuvers.
resume.yenx.education: M.U.T. Academy, 7 yrs. Specialist as Vopation Radar Analyzer.
resume.yenx.strengths: Very quick with both natural judgment and body reactions to stressful situations. Very resilient.
resume.yenx.weakness: Sometimes a dreamer and can easily be distracted.
crew.craven.name: Craven
resume.craven.name: Craven Micheals
resume.craven.qualifications: Expert on all weapons systems. Desurpelator programmer and debugger.
resume.craven.education: Field experience & 4 yrs. Sovian Engineering School, Jagon Territory.
resume.craven.strengths: Easy going, loyal. Very good troubleshooting skills. Communicates very well with crew & command.
resume.craven.weakness: Tends to be passive by nature and clumsy in stressful situations.
crew.wilfo.name: Wilfo
resume.wilfo.name: Wilfo
resume.wilfo.qualifications: Qualified shield system engineer. Programming and device modification courses.
resume.wilfo.education: Jovin Institute, studied mathematical theory applied engineering, 4 yrs.
resume.wilfo.experience: New graduate. Has no field experience.
resume.wilfo.strengths: Good under stress. Very friendly, but keeps to himslf generally. Loyal. Has telepathic skills.
resume.wilfo.weakness: Excitable and has a temper when challenged. Rather frail physical specimen.
crew.tony.name: Anthony
resume.tony.name: Anthony Frisina
resume.tony.qualifications: Expert technical knowledge of all systems & very good programming ablities.
resume.tony.education: University of Arcon, applied engineering and theory. Top in class.
resume.tony.experience: Engineering chief at Earth base for 5 yrs.
resume.tony.strengths: Extremely quick. Effective communicator and engineering analyst. Very loyal and friendly.
resume.tony.weakness: Tends to be worrisome in stressful situations.
crew.fligrnk.name: Fligronk
resume.fligrnk.name: Fligronk Plgzur
resume.fligrnk.qualifications: Qualified Thermogaggon Propulsion Sys. engineer Expert device modifier.
resume.fligrnk.education: 1 yr. Engineering Correspondence School, Tech. Institute of Rapion.
resume.fligrnk.experience: 2 yrs. field work with Rapion mapping team.
resume.fligrnk.strengths: Very resilient. Loyal and very serious about his job. Keeps to himself generally.
resume.fligrnk.weakness: Excitable nature and has a violent temper when threatened or challenged.
crew.sheema.name: Sheema
resume.sheema.name: Sheema Sampu
resume.sheema.qualifications: Good, logical thinking mind. Strong performer on all defensive systems.
resume.sheema.education: Graduate of Space History and Applied Device Design Institute.
resume.sheema.experience: Many exploratory missions with Earth teams.
resume.sheema.strengths: Above average ruggedness. Very good with vaccdroid communication. Has some telepathic skills.
resume.sheema.weakness: Can be overly deliberate with her duties. Doesn't like risky or stressful situations.
crew.vx4.name: VX-4
resume.vx4.name: VX-4 (Vaccdroid)
resume.vx4.qualifications: All new systems training and memory translator banks. Latest sensory detector.
resume.vx4.education: All knowledge banks programmed at the Systems Control Institute.
resume.vx4.strengths: This model generally shows extreme ruggedness and top stress handling ability.
resume.vx4.weakness: Although individual units vary, this model generally performs slower than most.
crew.anxy.name: Anxy
resume.anxy.name: Anxy
resume.anxy.qualifications: Expert, experienced instructor in shield and reactor maintenance.
resume.anxy.education: Vectoroum Technical School 4 yrs. specialty courses.
resume.anxy.experience: 20 yrs. service with Jovian attack bases.
resume.anxy.strengths: Very friendly, reliable and likable. Loyal to upper command as well as peers.
resume.anxy.weakness: Doesn't like to be interrupted or hurried while working. Also doesn't like high risk missions.
crew.t3.name: T3XR9
resume.t3.name: T3XR9 Model-4
resume.t3.qualifications: Designed for high speed repair and communications. Has extensive logic data.
resume.t3.education: Intensive data module was installed at the Vectoroum Tech.School.
resume.t3.strengths: This vaccdroid is extremely reliable & loyal. Very friendly. Hard working and precise.
resume.t3.weakness: Sometimes can overwork himself because of his extreme loyalty. Is not self-motivating.
crew.vofgank.name: Volfgank
resume.vofgank.name: Volfgank (Hank)
resume.vofgank.qualifications: Specializes in complex Robodroid analysis and defensive shield repair.
resume.vofgank.education: Specialist training at the Tancred School of Technology.
resume.vofgank.strengths: Initiates repairs. Precise, reliable worker. Vast knowledge of alien radar flight devices.
resume.vofgank.weakness: Loner type. Keeps to himself. Also is not a good communicator. Doesn't like high risk assignments.
crew.ryblo.name: Ryblo
resume.ryblo.name: Ryblo Flarn
resume.ryblo.qualifications: Expert at programming and analysis of Frapiod Defense Pod.
resume.ryblo.education: No formal study. 10 yrs. of contract work around Jagon territory.
resume.ryblo.strengths: Precise, reliable work. Works well with peers and is a very good source for contraband.
resume.ryblo.weakness: Is sometimes lazy and has a temper. Also has a hard time communicating with upper command.
crew.bru.name: Bru
resume.bru.name: Bru Marmo
resume.bru.qualifications: Expert on Droid Defusion units Good with reactors and info scanning equipment.
resume.bru.education: Studied 10 yrs. at Techoroum Technical School. Mastered vector repulating.
resume.bru.experience: Operated repair facility on Delfan for 2 yrs.
resume.bru.strengths: Very aggressive and honest nature. Works very hard and is a good leader and coordinator.
resume.bru.weakness: Sometimes displays a 'bossy' attitude towards peers. Has offended superior officers in past.
crew.swigltz.name: Swiglitz
resume.swigltz.name: Swiglitz
resume.swigltz.qualifications: Expert at repairing cannon, thermo missile and blaster systems.
resume.swigltz.education: Studied 2 yrs. at Techoroum Technical School, Vrotron device repair.
resume.swigltz.experience: 3 yrs. Earth base repair, 1 yr. as apprentice.
resume.swigltz.strengths: Performs well in stressful situations. Can execute orders well. Loyal & friendly.
resume.swigltz.weakness: Has some old enemy- aquaintances who seem to track his whereabouts. Weak on engine repairs.
msg.alzott.kill: Sighted enemy target. Engaged and destroyed, sir.
msg.alzott.ordersDone: Reporting all requested firing orders have been accomplished.
msg.alzott.ownInitiative: Be advised that I have engaged a target of opportunity.
msg.alzott.lootStart: Pirates have gotten aboard! Get those thieves!
msg.alzott.lootEnd: Pirates chewed up the cargo area pretty bad! We'd better keep on our toes. Can't have this happen again!
msg.alzott.missileDamaged: Missile system damaged! It works but I have to have more power!
msg.alzott.missileDisabled: Guidance gyro in missile weapon must be repaired or the system is useless!
msg.alzott.missileDestroyed: Missile weapon system has been completely destroyed!
msg.alzott.blasterDamaged: I need more power, sir! Blaster has been damaged!
msg.alzott.blasterDisabled: Immediate repairs on the blaster are necessary! It is broken!
msg.alzott.blasterDestroyed: Blaster weapon system has been reduced to space dust! NEED HELP!
msg.alzott.cannonDamaged: Damaged cannon weapon system. Functions but I need more power, sir!
msg.alzott.cannonDisabled: Breech blocks frozen! Cannon system useless until repair completed!
msg.alzott.cannonDestroyed: Cannon weapon system melted. Now a giant pile of space junk!
msg.alzott.thermoDamaged: Damage to thermo weapon system! More power please!
msg.alzott.thermoDisabled: Thermo weapon system broken! Reactor rods melted! Useless until fixed!
msg.anxy.ordersDone: All assigned tasks have been completed as you requested, sir.
msg.anxy.ownInitiative: Although you didn't request it, I took the opportunity to start working on some items which needed repair.
msg.anxy.lootStart: Those dirty pirates are stealing our cargo!
msg.anxy.lootEnd: The pirates are leaving! I hope we still have some cargo to deliver!
msg.anxy.robo2Damaged: Robodroid two is out of action until we can get him fixed!
msg.anxy.robo2Disabled: Robodroid two has been hit again! He is in worse shape!
msg.anxy.robo2Destroyed: Robodroid two was just blown to smithereens!
msg.anxy.robo5Damaged: Robodroid five can't function until we get him repaired!
msg.anxy.robo5Disabled: They shot robodroid five again. Now it'll take much more time to fix him!
msg.anxy.robo5Destroyed: Oh, no! Robodroid five has just been blasted into space dust!
msg.anxy.robo7Damaged: Robodroid seven is damaged and can no longer function until fixed!
msg.anxy.robo7Disabled: Robodroid seven just got clobbered again!
msg.anxy.robo7Destroyed: We need to give robodroid seven last rites. If only he had a soul.
msg.aymu.noEvasive: Evasive manuverink iz impossible because retros don't verk properly
msg.aymu.noTurnPort: Ve are unable tu change course tu port since da starboard retro iz broke.
msg.aymu.noTurnStarboard: Ve are unable tu change course tu starboard, since da port retro iz not vurking.
msg.aymu.riskyArea: Ve must be careful since ve are now enterink a sector vit much reported pirate acttivity.
msg.aymu.lifeSupportWarn: I be vuried bout me life support system. Iz braken und not vurkink vell. Pleez inform repair at yur urleust kunvenyunz. Tanku.
msg.aymu.lifeSupportCritical: Me life support system kent support me life much longur......Pleez tell dose lagards in repair tu vake up!
msg.aymu.lootStart: Dem pirate scum hav started lootink. Pleez tell repair to hurry so ve can still salvage sum uv our cargo.
msg.aymu.lootEnd: Doz pirates are leavink. I hope der iz enuf cargo left to make dis trip vorth finishink vit sum bonus.
msg.aymu.engine1Damaged: Engine vun iz not vurkink tu good and needs sum fixink.
msg.aymu.engine1Disabled: Engine vun don't vurk at all!
msg.aymu.engine1Destroyed: Engine vun iz broke tu bad tu be fixed!
msg.aymu.engine2Damaged: Engine two need sum repair kuz it not vurkink tu good.
msg.aymu.engine2Destroyed: Engine two iz destroyed by blast.
msg.aymu.portRetroDamaged: Retro on port zide iz not responsiv.
msg.aymu.portRetroDisabled: Pleez tell repair dat de port retro kwit vurkink.
msg.aymu.portRetroDestroyed: Port retro haz bin turned into lump uv melted metal!
msg.aymu.starRetroDisabled: Retro on starboard side not vurkink at all.
msg.aymu.starRetroDestroyed: Starboard retro haz bin destroyed. Vat du ve do now?
msg.blustan.navSuffocated: We'll never see the navigator again, sir. He's run out of air!
msg.blustan.engLifeSupportDeath: Another engineer bites the dust, sir. He froze to death!
msg.blustan.navKilled: Oh, stars! They got the navigator!
msg.blustan.selfHit: They're hitting us all over! I've been hit....Oh, stars!!...
msg.blustan.weaponsKilled: Weapons specialist is wiped out! He was caught off guard. I bet he was daydreaming, that fool!
msg.blustan.repairKilled: We're really had! The repair officer is dead, sir!
msg.blustan.cargoHit: Some cargo has been shot up! There goes my lunch!
msg.blustan.lootStart: Looting has begun! Oh, stars! Let's try and get 'em!
msg.blustan.lootEnd: The vultures are finally gone! I recognized some of those thieves from my college days!
msg.blustan.contactAlert: Heads up! Danger approaching,... philosophically speaking!
msg.blustan.cargoSpoiling: Computers indicate cargo is beginning to spoil. Lets get going!
msg.blustan.examsDone: Requested examinations completed! That's all, folks! OK to proceed, sir.
msg.blustan.ownInitiative: I just thought I'd check out a few things, sir!
msg.blustan.infoScanDamaged: Information scanner is barely working, sir! Call repair!
msg.blustan.infoScanDisabled: Doesn't look good! Info scanner is inoperative! Need help. NOW!
msg.blustan.infoScanDestroyed: Info scan is gone! My enthusiasm is dampening, sir!
msg.blustan.trackLockDamaged: Call repair! Without our tracking lock system we're candidates for the space grave!
msg.blustan.trackLockDisabled: Tracking system is broken! Need repair immediately!
msg.blustan.trackLockDestroyed: Tracking system melted! Time to will my spacely goods to my pet skork!
msg.blustan.cargoEnvDamaged: Cargo environment sys. took a hit!
msg.blustan.cargoEnvDisabled: Cargo environment sys. really looks bad! Help!
msg.blustan.cargoEnvDestroyed: Cargo is in trouble! Environment sys. is useless!
msg.blustan.cargoStabDamaged: Stabilization unit in cargo is damaged! Where in heck is repair?
msg.blustan.cargoStabDisabled: Cargo in trouble! No stabilization. Get that bucket of bolts from repair down here!
msg.blustan.cargoStabDestroyed: No stabilization! That's it for the cargo!
msg.boris.kill: Bingo! Another target destroyed. I love the smell of melted metal!
msg.boris.ordersDone: Firing tasks complete. I'm just waiting for those skorkies to try something. I'll nail 'em!
msg.boris.ownInitiative: It comes naturally for me to react well in combat! You can count on me. I love combat!
msg.boris.lootStart: We've got to get them! We can't lose our cargo!
msg.boris.lootEnd: Let's go after them! Those dogs! Make 'em eat space dirt!
msg.boris.missileDamaged: I am taking more power to work the damaged missile system
msg.boris.missileDisabled: I need one of those robodroids on the missile system! NOW! This thing is broken!
msg.boris.missileDestroyed: Missile system useless! Get the trash out of here.
msg.boris.blasterDamaged: Give me more power! Blaster damaged! It's a pig to fire! We're vulnerable.
msg.boris.blasterDisabled: That's it! Blaster is inoperable. Get someone up here now!
msg.boris.blasterDestroyed: Blaster blown! There're nothing but jerks around here!
msg.boris.cannonDamaged: Cannon weapon malfunction. I've got to have power!
msg.boris.cannonDisabled: Where are those stupid robodroids? I can't use the cannon at all.
msg.boris.thermoDamaged: Thermo weapon system damaged! It's going to require more power to function
msg.boris.thermoDisabled: Our goose is cooked! Thermo is broken. Get it fixed!
msg.boris.thermoDestroyed: Thermo weapon system blown to bits! Not a bit left to salvage.
msg.bronx.noEvasive: I can't manage evasive maneuvering because of our malfunctioning retros
msg.bronx.noTurnPort: I'm unable to change course to port. Starboard retro is not working, sir.
msg.bronx.noTurnStarboard: Starboard course change impossible! Our port retro is broken!
msg.bronx.riskyArea: We should not enter this quadrant of the galaxy. It is a very risky area!
msg.bronx.evasiveStart: Hold on! I'm taking evasive action!
msg.bronx.lifeSupportWarn: I'm a little worried about my life support...I'm getting light headed ......sir!
msg.bronx.lifeSupportCritical: Please! My life support is not working properly. It's becoming very hard to maneuver! Please!
msg.bronx.lootStart: My stars! I can't believe it. We're being looted! I really did try to maneuver the best I could!
msg.bronx.lootEnd: I'm so sorry! Are we all right? At least the looters have left!
msg.bronx.engine1Damaged: There's a problem with engine one! Get repair to look into it please.
msg.bronx.engine1Disabled: Engine one is badly damaged! Sir, could you please get us some help!
msg.bronx.engine1Destroyed: Engine one is useless. It's blasted! I don't know how long I can maintain our current situation.
msg.bronx.engine2Damaged: Engine two is starting to fail, sir! Please call repair ASAP!
msg.bronx.engine2Disabled: Engine two is now nonfunctional! HELP!
msg.bronx.engine2Destroyed: This is terrible! Engine two is completely burned out!
msg.bronx.portRetroDamaged: The port retro is acting up, sir. I think it's damaged!
msg.bronx.portRetroDisabled: Our port retro is not functional!
msg.bronx.portRetroDestroyed: Oh!..This is terrible! Port retro is gone!
msg.bronx.starRetroDamaged: Oh! It looks like the starboard retro has been damaged!
msg.bronx.starRetroDisabled: I can't keep the starboard retro going and I can't seem to steer.
msg.bronx.starRetroDestroyed: Oh, no! Starboard retro is useless!

msg.t3.robo5Damaged: Robodroid five, infrared scan eye damaged in transit. Will have to be repaired.
msg.t3.robo5Disabled: Robo five, sir, has been hit by enemy shot. Will get him back, as soon as possible.
msg.t3.robo5Destroyed: Five is inoperative. Obliterated robo scrap...Oh, he was a good friend.
msg.t3.robo7Damaged: Robodroid seven is damaged! Is unable to help with current tasks.
msg.t3.robo7Disabled: ZURK...Robo seven...has been hit by fire, extensive damage!
msg.tegra.noEvasive: Evasive maneuvers! Hey!...I can't fly this tin can with retros malfunctioning!
msg.tegra.noTurnPort: No course change to port, sir. Broken starboard retro.
msg.tegra.noTurnStarboard: No course change to starboard, sir. Port retro broken.
msg.tegra.riskyArea: This is NOT the in place to be! I'd get our astrobuns out of here!
msg.tegra.lifeSupportWarn: The Grand Karma is testing me again! Problems with my life support!
msg.tegra.lifeSupportCritical: Intuition tells me it's almost time to abandon ship. My life support ain't working!!
msg.tegra.engine1Damaged: I need repair up here! Engine one is malfunctioning!
msg.tegra.engine1Disabled: It will be quite a feat if those repair guys can pull us out of this one. Engine one is bad!
msg.tegra.engine2Damaged: We ALL need some cosmic guidance. We've got trouble with engine two!
msg.tegra.engine2Disabled: I'd rather be out catching butterflies. Get help for engine two!
msg.tegra.engine2Destroyed: Is it time to prepare ourselves for extinction? Engine two is gone.
msg.tegra.portRetroDamaged: A jog to the right is going to be tough. Port retro seems damaged!
msg.tegra.portRetroDisabled: The broken port retro will make it impossible unless those idiots in repair get crackin'.
msg.tegra.starRetroDamaged: It's a good thing that I'm not the nervous, twitchy type. We've got a problem with the starboard retro!
msg.tegra.starRetroDisabled: Some robodroid had better get in gear! Starboard retro still broken!
msg.tegra.starRetroDestroyed: We're running out of options, Captain. Starboard retro useless!
msg.tony.lifeSupportCritical: My life support is failing! HELP!
msg.tony.lifeSupportWarn: Hey guys, I need repair to please fix my life support system! NOW!
msg.tony.lootStart: What's going on down there? Looters!
msg.tony.lootEnd: They're gone! I hope that this kind of thing doesn't affect our bonus money!
msg.tony.reactor1Damaged: Number one reactor took a hit. It's going to need help!
msg.tony.reactor1Disabled: Number one reactor is down and almost at meltdown. Get repair! FAST!
msg.tony.reactor1Destroyed: Number one reactor bought it! I'll give you all I've got from reactor two!
msg.tony.reactor2Damaged: Reactor two is smoking from damage! I'll disable it if it gets too hot.
msg.tony.reactor2Disabled: Reactor two is down! It took a direct hit. I'll do whatever I can.
msg.tony.reactor2Destroyed: This stinks! Reactor two is evaporated!
msg.tony.ownLifeSupportDamaged: My life support needs fixing! Of course if you don't want me around, don't bother.
msg.tony.ownLifeSupportDisabled: This has gone far enough! Life support critical! Where's my help!
msg.tony.ownLifeSupportDestroyed: HELP ME! MY life support unit has blasted to bits!
msg.tony.navLifeSupportDamaged: My readings show navigator's life support system is in trouble.
msg.tony.navLifeSupportDisabled: Navigator's life support system is down.
msg.tony.navLifeSupportDestroyed: Navigator's life support unit was destroyed. Should we tell him?
msg.tony.cravenlatorDamaged: My console says the Cravenlator is damaged. ....What's a Cravenlator?
msg.tony.cravenlatorDisabled: Still looking for the Cravenlator. Console says it's broken but I can't find it.
msg.tony.cravenlatorDestroyed: The stupid Cravenlator is finished but it probably won't matter! HA!
msg.vofgank.ordersDone: I have completed all required repair orders.
msg.vofgank.ownInitiative: I sometimes get a little bored when there is no action, so I have gone ahead and done some repairs.
msg.vofgank.lootStart: What do we do now, Captain? We have looters down here!
msg.vofgank.lootEnd: Oh, I'm glad those cosmic clods are gone!
msg.vofgank.robo2Damaged: Robodroid two has been damaged, and things are getting busy down here. Two will be unable to help!
msg.vofgank.robo2Disabled: Robodroid two is out of order!
msg.vofgank.robo5Damaged: Robodroid five is down with a damaged motivator.
msg.vofgank.robo5Disabled: While being repaired, robo five received another hit from the enemy!
msg.vofgank.robo5Destroyed: Robo five is out of commission!
msg.vofgank.robo7Damaged: Getting crazy down here! Now robodroid seven is damaged, unable to work.
msg.vofgank.robo7Disabled: We're losing robos right and left! Robo seven is broken!
msg.vx4.lifeSupportCritical: Urgent! Urgent! I only have enough life for a few more millisecs.
msg.vx4.lifeSupportWarn: My external and internal function operators indicate I have problems with my life support.
msg.vx4.lootStart: Looters entering from all outer posts!
msg.vx4.lootEnd: The last of the looters have made their exit from the ship!
msg.vx4.reactor1Damaged: Detecting reactor one has malfunctioned. Will analyze problem.
msg.vx4.reactor1Disabled: My analysis of reactor one has detected a broken cooler. Needs repair.
msg.vx4.reactor2Damaged: Probe unit has informed me of a problem in reactor two.
msg.vx4.reactor2Disabled: Probe analyzed. Core leak. Request repair immediately.
msg.vx4.reactor2Destroyed: Reactor two was critical. Now useless.
msg.vx4.ownLifeSupportDamaged: My life support energy pack is showing a warning light. Send repair!
msg.vx4.ownLifeSupportDisabled: Even though I am a vaccdroid, my life support energy pack is broken.
msg.vx4.navLifeSupportDamaged: Analyzed environment data from navigation. It indicates his life support is damaged.
msg.vx4.navLifeSupportDisabled: Navigator life support system needs immediate attention.
msg.vx4.navLifeSupportDestroyed: Navigator life support unit is history.
msg.vx4.cravenlatorDisabled: Action on repair of Cravenlator requested.
msg.wilfo.lifeSupportCritical: My life support sys.seems to have a problem! Requesting help. Please!
msg.wilfo.lifeSupportWarn: Please get repair! My life support is failing! HELP! Please, sir!
msg.wilfo.lootStart: Oh! I sense that intruders are looting our cargo!
msg.wilfo.lootEnd: I sense that those pirates have gone! I hope that we didn't lose all our cargo, sir.
msg.wilfo.reactor1Damaged: Reactor one has been damaged! Half power is all it can give.
msg.wilfo.reactor1Disabled: Get repair up here! Reactor one will explode is not repaired!
msg.wilfo.reactor1Destroyed: Reactor one has melted! I sense we're in deep trouble!
msg.wilfo.reactor2Damaged: Only partial power from reactor two. It has taken a hit!
msg.wilfo.reactor2Disabled: Reactor two is near meltdown! Please get a robodroid up here!
msg.wilfo.reactor2Destroyed: Reactor two is gone! Had to jettison it for our safety!
msg.wilfo.ownLifeSupportDamaged: I'm having problems with my life support system. Please get repair!
msg.wilfo.ownLifeSupportDisabled: My own life support sys. is broken! Sir, HELP?
msg.wilfo.navLifeSupportDamaged: Trouble with our navigator's life support system. He needs help!
msg.wilfo.navLifeSupportDisabled: Navigator is in deep space bung! His life support is inoperative!
msg.wilfo.navLifeSupportDestroyed: Navigator's life support system obliterated! Oh well!
msg.wilfo.cravenlatorDamaged: Cravenlator is in trouble. I need repair to take a look!
msg.yeela.kill: I just blasted that scum into cosmic dust! I'll get'em!
msg.yeela.ordersDone: I have finished all my assignments per your request, sir.
msg.yeela.ownInitiative: Since I didn't hear from you...I decided to blast those galactic rats myself!
msg.yeela.lootStart: Those rotten pirates have boarded us and are stealing our cargo!!
msg.yeela.lootEnd: Whew! I'm glad those scum are leaving! Those space creeps!
msg.yeela.missileDamaged: Missile system has been damaged...so you better turn up the juice to get them to work, sir!
msg.yeela.missileDisabled: Tell repair to try to fix the missile system!
msg.yeela.missileDestroyed: The missile system has been wiped out!
msg.yeela.blasterDamaged: Have engineering turn up the blaster power to allow it to function until repairs can be done, sir.
msg.yeela.blasterDisabled: Blaster is out of action! Get repair!
msg.yeela.blasterDestroyed: They just blasted our blasted blaster to pieces!
msg.yeela.cannonDamaged: Need to crank up the power to the cannon to get them to work until repair gets to them, sir.
msg.yeela.cannonDisabled: Cannon is broken. We've got to get it fixed!
msg.yeela.cannonDestroyed: Those scum have melted the cannon!
msg.yeela.thermoDamaged: It's going to require an increase in energy to keep the damaged thermo weapon working, sir.
msg.yeela.thermoDisabled: Please notify repair that the thermo weapon has been knocked out!
msg.yenx.noEvasive: The retros are not working very well so we can't take evasive action
msg.yenx.noTurnPort: The starboard retro is broken so we can't turn in the port direction.
msg.yenx.noTurnStarboard: The port retro is broken so we can't turn in the starbroad direction.
msg.yenx.riskyArea: We must proceed with caution since we are entering a dangerous area.
msg.yenx.evasiveStart: We shall start evasive maneuvering now.
msg.yenx.lifeSupportWarn: I'm concerned because....my ...life support system appears to be malfunctioning!
msg.yenx.lifeSupportCritical: Help...me...! Please hurry and get repair to help me! My life support is not working. I'm dying.
msg.yenx.lootStart: Those dirty pirates are taking our cargo! Please do something to stop them so we will earn some bonus money for this trip!
msg.yenx.lootEnd: Thank goodness those scummy pirates are gone!
msg.yenx.engine1Damaged: We are having trouble with engine one.
msg.yenx.engine1Destroyed: What can we do now? Engine one has been destroyed!
msg.yenx.engine2Damaged: Engine two has been damaged and is barely working.
msg.yenx.engine2Destroyed: We are in big trouble! Engine two has been blown to pieces!
msg.yenx.portRetroDamaged: The port retro is acting flakey!
msg.yenx.portRetroDisabled: I need some help. The port retro is broken.
msg.yenx.portRetroDestroyed: We got trouble. The port retro has been ruined beyond repair!
msg.yenx.starRetroDamaged: Please have repair examine the retro on the starboard side.
msg.yenx.starRetroDisabled: The starboard retro is not working at all!
msg.yenx.starRetroDestroyed: The starboard retro is so badly damaged that it can't be repaired!
